result.title: StyleID++: Position-Decoupled and Structure-Coherent Style Retrieval across Diffusion Architectures
result.summary: Attention injection offers a remarkably simple route to training-free style transfer: content queries retrieve style keys and values inside a pretrained diffusion model. We show that this operation also creates an overlooked failure mode. Position signals that are useful within one image become a spurious shared coordinate system across two spatially unrelated images, causing content tokens to favor style tokens at similar coordinates. This cross-image positional leakage appears in both convolutional U-Nets and diffusion transformers (DiTs), despite their different position mechanisms. Removing the positional shortcut exposes a second problem: unconstrained global retrieval lets related content tokens select incompatible style regions, producing fragmented appearance. We present StyleID++, a training-free framework that addresses the two problems jointly. Position-Decoupled Retrieval reduces coordinate-dependent matching through circular padding in U-Nets and injection-only RoPE removal in DiTs, while preserving native position modeling elsewhere. Affinity-Coherent Refinement then regularizes style assignments with the content self-attention graph, encouraging structurally related tokens to retrieve compatible style evidence. We quantify the leakage with a coordinate--centroid correlation and a permutation test on the style reference. The permutation error can be driven to zero in both backbones, which identifies the position mechanism as the carrier of the leakage, and StyleID++ obtains the best ArtFID of all methods we compare.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出基于 attention injection 的免训练风格迁移存在跨图像位置泄漏：content 查询会因坐标相似而检索到 style token；据此提出 StyleID++，在 U-Net 中用 circular padding、在 DiT 中仅对注入处移除 RoPE 来解耦位置，并用 content self-attention 图约束风格分配的一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其位置捷径诊断（坐标—质心相关、置换测试）与基于自注意力图的结构一致性正则，可能可供核查 LVR 中位置编码与注意力结构如何干扰 latent 检索和视觉证据筛选；但该工作属图像风格迁移，需自行判断可迁移性。
